verdict.rationale: Jitsu Functions are a documented, first-party way to filter, transform and modify events in JavaScript/TypeScript before they reach a destination. This gives a privacy lead a way to strip or alter sensitive fields in the pipeline. However, the evidence describes no built-in PII controls: hashing or masking would have to be hand-coded, filtering is described at the event level rather than per field, and per-destination scoping is only implied. Missing for 10: built-in hashing/masking of PII, explicit field-level redaction, documented per-destination PII policies, independent corroboration.
